description: This file defines an Angular component named JournalListComponent used for displaying and managing a list of journal entries. It handles filtering, loading data from a service, and deleting entries.

classes.name: JournalListComponent
classes.description: Angular component responsible for displaying and managing a list of journal entries, including filtering, loading data, and deletion.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component, sets up debounce for search inputs, and loads initial journal entries.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up subscriptions upon component destruction.

methods.name: onFiltersChanged
methods.description: Triggered when filter inputs change; emits a debounce event to reload data.

methods.name: clearFilters
methods.description: Resets filters to default values and reloads the journal entries.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches journal entries from the service based on current filters, sorts them, and handles loading/error state.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a journal entry after user confirmation and reloads the list.

ctags.name: ok
ctags.pattern: /^    const ok = confirm(`Delete "${entry.title}"? This cannot be undone.`);$/
